claim_disclosure: verify-control succeeded before claim; 0 unrelated running leases; supervisor v2 has no targeted claim selector, so priority was lowered 5->-3 under Lock(), the supervisor-signed claim ran for the unique worker, and priority was restored to 5 under a second Lock().
